findings.justification: Cash and equivalents increased from $8.2B to $14.3B (73% increase), which is a positive indicator. However, this is only one component of the balance sheet and does not alone establish whether the overall balance sheet position is materially stronger.

Long-term debt decreased from $46.3B to $44.1B (4.7% decrease), which is a positive indicator. However, this is only one component of the balance sheet and does not alone establish whether the overall balance sheet position is materially stronger.

findings.key_quote: If we were to have applied our revised accounting position to the Consolidated Condensed Financial Statements as of September 27, 2025, the impact would be a decrease of $ 3.0 billion to total liabilities and an increase of $ 3.0 billion to total stockholders' equity
findings.justification: This describes an accounting revision that would have improved the balance sheet position (lower liabilities, higher equity) but refers to September 27, 2025, not the year-end comparison. It provides context about balance sheet changes but does not directly compare December 27, 2025 to December 28, 2024.

findings.key_quote: The fair value of the Escrowed Shares derivative liability was $ 2.7 billion at December 27, 2025, which we have recognized within other accrued liabilities and other long-term liabilities
findings.justification: This discloses a $2.7B derivative liability at year-end 2025 but does not provide the comparable figure for 2024, so it cannot establish whether this component improved or worsened year-over-year.

findings.key_quote: We had over $100 billion of property, plant and equipment, net on our balance sheet as of December 27, 2025
findings.justification: This provides the level of PP&E at year-end 2025 but does not provide the comparable figure for 2024, so it cannot establish whether this component changed year-over-year.
